turns.replyTail:
f I need it sooner?

If you need an item sooner, we offer a Rush Order Service that prioritizes your piece for expedited production and processing.
Additionally, you can choose expedited shipping options at checkout, such as Express Shipping (2–3 business days) or Rush Delivery (1–2 business days) after processing.
If your order has already been placed and you'd like to see if it can be expedited, please let me know and I can help connect you with our support team to look into your options!

What should I do if the tracking never updates?
menu
If your tracking number hasn't updated after 1 to 2 business days from receiving your shipping email, it may simply be waiting for the carrier's initial scan.
hello@kinnstudio.com

turns.replyTail:
Here to help you shop
menu
How do I find my tracking link?
You can find your tracking link in the shipping confirmation email sent to you once your order has processed and shipped.
If you have an account with us, you can also log in to view your order history and tracking updates directly.
If you're unable to locate the confirmation email or your tracking details, please share the email address associated with your order, and I can help open a support request for our team to locate it for you!
